references.title: del statement
references.summary: Official Python reference for deleting names, attributes, items, or slices.
references.syntax:
del variable
del items[0]
del row["column"]

references.title: with statement

references.syntax:

references.title: comprehensions
references.summary: Official Python reference for list, set, and dict comprehensions.
references.syntax:
squares = [x ** 2 for x in numbers]
by_id = {row["id"]: row for row in rows}

references.title: f-string
references.summary: Official Python documentation for formatted string literals (f-strings).
references.syntax:
name = 'Alice'
age = 30
print(f'Hello {name}')          # Hello Alice
print(f'Age: {age}')            # Age: 30
print(f'Pi: {3.14159:.2f}')    # Pi: 3.14
print(f'{age * 2 = }')         # age * 2 = 60  (debug)
print(f'{name!r}')              # 'Alice' (repr)

references.title: walrus operator :=
references.summary: Official Python documentation for the walrus (assignment expression) operator.
references.syntax:
# Присвоение и проверка в одном выражении
if (n := len(data)) > 10:
    print(f'Too long: {n} items')

# В while
while chunk := file.read(1024):
    process(chunk)

# В list comprehension
filtered = [y for x in data if (y := transform(x)) > 0]

references.title: match / case
references.summary: Official Python documentation for structural pattern matching (Python 3.10+).
references.syntax:
command = 'quit'
match command:
    case 'quit':
        print('Quitting')
    case 'help':
        print('Help')
    case _:
        print('Unknown')

# Matching with values
match point:
    case (0, 0):
        print('Origin')
    case (x, 0):
        print(f'X={x}')
